name: matlab-extract-battery-features
description: Extract battery features in MATLAB from voltage, current, and temperature measurements: multi-cycle cycling tests, HPPC / pulse tests, EIS impedance sweeps, or a single in-field charge or discharge segment. Use when the user asks for battery features, or for SOH, RUL, degradation, internal-resistance, or impedance analysis that needs them. Output is a feature table; does not train SOH / RUL models. Do not trigger only because battery data is present. Triggers on battery* functions such as batteryTestDataParser, batteryTestFeatureExtractor, batteryPulseFeatures, batteryEISFeatures.
